caption: The drawing depicts a realistic and detailed rendering of a pair of work gloves, placed palm-up and slightly cupped together. The gloves are illustrated in graphite or charcoal on a light beige paper background. The shading and texture closely mimic the soft, worn fabric of the gloves, including creases, folds, and subtle details such as the seams and edges. The cuffs of the gloves are scrunched and gathered together at the top left of the image, with the fingers and palms forming the fuller, rounded lower portion of the composition. The entire drawing is centered on the page, with no other objects or details in the background, and the artist's signature, "Helen Hobart," is visible in the lower left corner. The overall color scheme is monochromatic, with varying shades of gray and black used to create depth and dimensionality.
title: Visiting Card Tray
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
